CustomField.description: Date from the row, parsed with the mapping profile's declared date format and never guessed: the trade date for Trade rows, the as-of date for AUM rows, or the effective date for Code Roster rows. API name kept from phase 2 to avoid breaking deployed code. Blank if the value could not be parsed (see Validation Errors).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The trade date, AUM as-of date or code effective date, depending on the row type.
CustomField.label: Row Date
